content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6 to 2.2 g of protein per kg of body weight per day. Going above that doesn't add muscle, and 1.6 g/kg is already enough for most people.

💡 Spread it over 3 to 5 meals with roughly 0.3 to 0.4 g/kg each. Keep total calories at or slightly above maintenance, because that matters just as much for gaining muscle.

What's your body weight? I can work out your daily number.
